claims.text: The model makes mistakes due to underspecified frames, leading to ambiguous interpretations of relationships between objects.
Metaphorical language can confuse the model, as it may misinterpret abstract uses of verbs that do not align with physical attributes.
Frame and attribute similarity factors hinder the model's performance, contributing to incorrect predictions.
